title: AIGC and the Visual Symbol System of Tang Historical Painting: Six-Model, Three-Prompt-Condition Corpus (162 images)
description: Supplementary materials: 162 AI-generated images (6 models x 2 prompt conditions x 9 repetitions, plus training set), per-image coding table by two independent coders against 18 atomic indicators, three full prompt sets, decision-tree details, and ethics/compliance documentation. Images are AI-generated and published solely for critical scholarly analysis of historical distortion in T2I output.
